programs.name: validated_regime_seasonal
programs.description: Use when the series contains a recurring long cycle with level shifts and one rolling fold is materially worse than the others.
programs.assumption: On at least three rolling holdouts, some lag from 36 to 120 samples lowers median SMAPE by at least 0.2 percentage points versus persistence, while its worst-fold SMAPE remains below 3.0%.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when no candidate seasonal lag beats persistence on median holdout SMAPE, or when a future structural break changes the cycle shape or level by more than twice the recent median absolute deviation.

programs.name: recursive_analog_ensemble
programs.description: Use when recurring shapes are present but their spacing or amplitude varies enough that a fixed seasonal period produces an isolated bad fold.
programs.assumption: For contexts of 8 to 24 samples, the median normalized distance to the three nearest historical analogs is below 0.75, and analog continuation improves median rolling SMAPE by at least 0.2 percentage points over a constant-last-value forecast.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when recent normalized shapes have no close historical analogs, when nearest-neighbor distances exceed 0.75, or when recursive predictions drift outside the historical robust range.
